ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, banking, appointment of directors, and material payments, identify and document all direct and indirect owners, controllers, directors, authorized signatories, and relevant counterparties. Screen against United Nations Security Council lists, European Union financial-sanctions lists, Spanish domestic sanctions and terrorist-financing measures, OFAC lists where there is a United States nexus, and reputable PEP databases. Apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs, their family members and known close associates; establish source of wealth and source of funds; obtain senior-management approval; apply enhanced ongoing monitoring; and retain evidence in accordance with Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014. OFAC is not automatically binding on a purely Spanish transaction without a United States nexus, but it is commercially relevant for United States banks, dollar clearing, United States persons, and United States-origin technology or services.
ubo_determination_rules: A natural person owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the capital or voting rights is a beneficial owner.

A natural person exercising control by other means, including shareholder agreements, appointment rights, dominant influence, or equivalent arrangements, is a beneficial owner regardless of the percentage held.

If no natural person can be identified after exhaustive reasonable measures, the senior managing official is recorded as the fallback beneficial owner, with the failed-identification analysis documented.
Nominee shareholders and directors do not replace the obligation to identify the person exercising ultimate ownership or control.
Ownership chains must be traced through every intermediate entity, trust, foundation, partnership, voting arrangement, and contractual control mechanism to the natural-person level.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.register_access_and_reporting: The Spanish Central Register of Beneficial Ownership is an official authority-accessible register. Access by obliged entities and other persons is subject to statutory conditions, identification, legitimate-interest requirements where applicable, data-protection restrictions, and the effects of applicable European Union case law. The company must maintain accurate beneficial-ownership information and provide it to the notary, Commercial Registry, tax authority, financial institution, and other obliged entities when lawfully requested.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.aml_risk_assessment: The proposed ASO, SEO, and multilingual localization agency is generally a low-to-standard inherent money-laundering risk business because it is a non-regulated professional-services activity with no cash-intensive model, no statutory financial license, and no custody of client funds. Risk increases if the company receives third-party funds, uses opaque offshore shareholders, provides nominee arrangements, handles digital assets, conducts high-value cross-border transactions, or has PEP, sanctions, tax-residency, or source-of-funds inconsistencies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central electronic portal (RMC), https://www.rmc.es; incorporation may also be processed through the CIRCE system and Points of Support for Entrepreneurs where eligible
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be distinct from existing registered names and must include the legal-form indication Sociedad Limitada, Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, or the permitted abbreviation S.L. or S.R.L. The name is generally filed in Spanish or another legally acceptable language and must not create confusion with an existing name, regulated activity, public authority, or protected designation. Foreign words, abbreviations, and transliterations may be accepted if they are not misleading and satisfy the Registrar's distinctiveness and legality assessment. A translated or commercial name does not substitute for the registered legal name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, banca, bank, banking, entidad de crédito, and equivalent banking terms
Seguro, aseguradora, insurance, reaseguro, and equivalent insurance terms
Financiera, financiera de crédito, investment fund, sociedad gestora, securities, bolsa, valores, broker, and other regulated-finance terms
Notario, abogado, auditor, official, ministerio, gobierno, real, royal, nacional, España, European Union, and equivalent public-authority or protected-status terms where misleading or unauthorized

Terms implying a licensed payment institution, electronic-money institution, investment firm, cryptocurrency service provider, telecommunications operator, university, medical provider, or other regulated activity
Names identical or confusingly similar to existing names, trademarks, public bodies, or protected geographical and institutional designations
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.name_reservation_legal_position: The RMC negative name certificate is generally valid for three months from issuance for execution of the incorporation deed. Once issued, the name is reserved in the relevant registry system for six months, after which the reservation may lapse if incorporation has not occurred. The 90-day certificate period, rather than a 30-day period, should be used for closing control.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Submit the name application electronically to the RMC with several ordered alternatives, the proposed legal-form suffix, applicant identification, and payment of the applicable fee. If rejected, review the stated ground, distinguishability analysis, and any objection or defect notice; submit a corrected application using a materially different name rather than relying on a minor spelling variation; and, where procedurally available, file a reasoned appeal or objection with the RMC within the period stated in the notice, supported by evidence of distinctiveness, consent, authorization, or non-confusion. A registrar's qualification may be challenged through the applicable Commercial Registry appeal route under the Commercial Registry Regulation and Spanish mortgage-registry appeal principles. Preserve the rejection notice, filing receipt, translations, trademark searches, and corporate authorizations. A successful name certificate does not itself confer trademark rights.
recommended_clearance_sequence: Conduct RMC, Spanish Trademark Office, European Union Intellectual Property Office, domain-name, and major-platform searches.
Prepare at least five non-descriptive alternatives and avoid terms suggesting a regulated activity or government affiliation.
Obtain the RMC negative name certificate before notarial execution of the incorporation deed.
Confirm that the proposed name is consistent with the actual business scope and does not imply financial, legal, employment, telecommunications, or other regulated services.
File trademark applications separately if brand protection is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.statutory_basis: A Spanish SL must have a registered office in Spain under the Capital Companies Act, including Articles 9 and 10 of Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010. The registered office must correspond to the company's effective administrative and management center or its principal establishment or operation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be acceptable for a non-regulated ASO, SEO, and localization agency if it is a genuine usable address, receives official notices, supports statutory books and corporate records, and does not misrepresent the location of effective management. A mailbox-only address, accommodation address without operational access, or address inconsistent with tax residence and management may create tax, banking, corporate, and substance risk. The company should maintain demonstrable Spanish management, accounting records, contractual files, communications, and operational capability proportionate to its activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official Spanish probability statistic is published. For a newly incorporated, low-risk, non-regulated digital agency with coherent tax, banking, payroll, ownership, and registered-office records, the planning assessment is low, approximately 5% to 10% over the first 24 months; this is a non-statutory risk estimate, not a guarantee. Risk increases materially following VAT-refund claims, suspected tax residence discrepancies, inconsistent management location, undeclared permanent establishments, AML alerts, related-party flows, or inability to receive official notices.
substance_requirements: Maintain a usable Spanish registered office and effective notice-receipt process.
Maintain Spanish corporate books, accounting records, contracts, invoices, and beneficial-ownership evidence.
Ensure directors and authorized representatives can demonstrate actual decision-making and authority.
Assess Spanish tax residence under the Corporate Income Tax Law based on registered office and effective management.
Evaluate VAT place-of-supply, permanent-establishment, transfer-pricing, payroll, and beneficial-ownership consequences for cross-border services.
Do not characterize Wise B2B or Payoneer accounts as substitutes for a regulated Spanish bank account or as authorization to provide payment services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; General Information Portal: https://www.agenciatributaria.es; OSS/VAT One-Stop-Shop digital portal: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/oss
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Obtain negative name certificate from Registro Mercantil Central; 2. Execute public incorporation deed (escritura de constitución) before a notary – minimum capital EUR 1 permitted under Ley Crea y Crece (Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva); 3. Notary requests provisional NIF (Modelo 036) simultaneously with deed filing; 4. Pay regional ITP-AJD stamp duty on capital (0.5%–1.5% depending on Autonomous Community); 5. Register the deed in the Mercantile Registry within one month of execution; 6. File final Modelo 036/037 with AEAT within one month of registry registration to obtain the definitive NIF (tax identification number), IVA census registration, and I.A.E. activity declaration; 7. The definitive Spanish tax ID for an SL is the NIF formatted as ES + 8 digits + checksum (e.g., ESB12345678), which simultaneously functions as the VAT number for intra-Community transactions; 8. Non-resident shareholders must obtain their own NIF for non-resident entities (Modelo 030) and may be required to appoint a fiscal representative before AEAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the SL is a fully resident corporation subject to Impuesto sobre Sociedades (CIT) at the standard 25% rate; there is no fiscal transparency or pass-through election for an SL; reduced 15% CIT applies to newly created entities for the first two years of positive taxable base (Art. 29.1 LIS) and to qualifying start-ups under Law 28/2022; foreign shareholders are separately taxed on distributions via IRNR (non-resident income tax) at 19%, subject to treaty relief.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or 'elective pass-through' regime exists for an SL; mandatory entity-level taxation applies; available statutory elections: (i) reduced 15% CIT for new entities under Art. 29.1 LIS; (ii) start-up corporate regime (15% rate, loss carryforward flexibility, special deferred payment) under Law 28/2022 subject to certification thresholds; (iii) tax consolidation for groups with ≥70% direct or indirect ownership (Arts. 58–70 LIS); (iv) IP Patent Box 60% exemption on qualifying intangible income (Art. 23 LIS); (v) M&A reorganization neutrality/rollover (Arts. 76–93 LIS); (vi) ETVE approved holdings regime for foreign shareholdings; (vii) OSS non-Union scheme registration for B2C digital services supplied to EU consumers; (viii) anti-hybrid and reverse-hybrid designations under Law 38/2022 (ATAD2 transposition), which supersede any contractual mismatch elections for structured arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) – EU-aligned Value Added Tax under Directive 2006/112/EC, implemented by Ley 37/1992 (LIVA) and RD 1624/1992
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 0 – no general VAT exemption or de minimis turnover threshold exists in Spain; an SL must file Modelo 036/037 and become an IVA-registered operator before performing any taxable transaction; SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) near-real-time filing becomes mandatory at annual turnover exceeding EUR 6,010,121.04; a EUR 10,000 threshold applies solely to intra-Community distance sales/online B2C supplies in the context of the special non-Union OSS scheme; the SEO/ASO localization agency therefore requires IVA registration from its first invoice.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing and near-real-time data supply in Spain: (i) SII real-time VAT record filing applies to companies with turnover > EUR 6,010,121.04, requiring submission of invoice records in XML v2.x via authenticated REST/API within 4 business days of issue (8 days for quarterly filers); (ii) Verifactu (RD 1007/2023) requires all remaining businesses to use certified billing software generating a traceable invoice register (Registro de Facturación) with QR-marking option; (iii) Ley Crea y Crece (Law 18/2022) mandates universal B2B e-invoicing in Facturae XML 3.2 or PEPPOL-BIS 3.0 formats, with phased implementation pending AEAT regulations; AEAT does not operate a pre-clearance fiscal stamping system, but performs automated cross-validation, formal rejection ('rechazo') notices, and near-real-time audit profiling of all digital invoice records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% IVA (exemption with credit/refund right) is available solely where: (a) goods physically leave EU customs territory under customs export procedure within 90 days, extendable up to 365 days, evidenced by an endorsed DUA (Art. 21 LIVA); or (b) services are supplied to a client established outside Spain, under the 'place-of-supply' B2B rule (recipient-jurisdiction taxation per Arts. 69.1 and 70 LIVA). For this SEO/ASO localization agency, search optimization, app-store optimization, and multilingual content localization services qualify as export services when delivered to non-Spanish clients: EU B2B clients trigger reverse-charge at the client's jurisdiction (invoice must show client VAT ID plus the clause 'Inversión del sujeto pasivo'); non-EU B2B clients are invoiced at 0% IVA with a reference to the applicable exemption article, provided the non-EU status and fiscal residence of the recipient are substantiated; B2C digital services to EU consumers are taxed at destination rates through OSS, not zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA/SAD) endorsed by AEAT Customs, evidencing the exit of any physical promotional or localization collateral goods from EU customs territory
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR transport document proving physical movement outside the EU where goods are exported
Inward Remittance Certificate – SWIFT MT103 or bank credit advice showing the exact invoice amount repatriated from the non-resident client's foreign bank account
VIES-validated EU VAT identification number of the B2B recipient, or Certificate of Fiscal Residence issued by the non-EU client's competent tax authority

Executed service agreement setting out the nature, destination, and consumption jurisdiction of the SEO/ASO localization services, together with the itemized commercial invoice citing the legal exemption basis (Art. 21/69/70 LIVA)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT applies big-data cross-validation across SII VAT records, customs DUA data, bank FX reporting (Ley 10/2010 AML filings), and VIES/CbCR data to detect fraudulent export zero-rating. Penalties and clawback consequences: (i) retrospectively assessed 21% IVA plus late-payment interest at the legal rate (currently 5.12% per annum) for up to 4 years from the filing deadline (extended to 10 years where the arrangement constitutes a simulated or abusive structure without economic substance); (ii) proportional penalty of 50% of the omitted IVA under Art. 191 LGT, reducible to 25% upon prompt voluntary payment; (iii) tariff surcharge of up to 150% when incorrect declarations are repeated; (iv) criminal liability under Art. 305 of the Código Penal where the defrauded Treasury amount exceeds EUR 120,000 per tax period, carrying imprisonment of 1–5 years and a fine of six times the defrauded amount; (v) for service exporters, AEAT may deny zero-rating entirely where the SL lacks demonstrable substance (offices, employees, management control in Spain) or where the non-EU client's fiscal residence certificate, VAT ID, or corresponding FX remittance trace is missing; (vi) clawback may extend to the full chain of invoices issued to the localization agency's foreign affiliates under transfer-pricing anti-abuse rules, with joint and several liability of directors for the surcharge and interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) within the European System of Central Banks and the Eurozone; foreign transaction statistical and foreign investment reporting is coordinated with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones of the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Tourism
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Capital and current account transactions are fully liberalized under Articles 63 and 64 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU and Spanish Royal Decree 1816/1991 on Economic Transactions Abroad. The euro is freely convertible. Profit remittance is not subject to exchange control approval; only the Non-Resident Income Tax withholding regime applies (generally 19%, reduced under applicable double-tax treaties). Balance-of-payments statistical declarations to the Banco de España may be required for certain transactions above regulatory thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender requirement or conversion ratio applies to export proceeds in Spain. Exporters may retain foreign currency indefinitely in accounts held with Spanish or foreign banks. For statistical purposes, export collections exceeding thresholds set by Banco de España circulars must be reported through the Correspondent Bank or the customer's declaration in the Balance of Payments system; no statutory timeline or mandatory conversion is imposed.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility as ancillary payment rails for operational treasury, vendor disbursements, and collections from Google/Apple/Amazon app store platforms. Wise (EEA-licensed payment institution / EMI under EU passporting) and Payoneer (authorized payment institution) may be used for cross-border USD/EUR settlements with lower fees. Legal constraints: these entities are not authorized to carry out full corporate banking services, cannot provide notary capital deposit certificates or cervical debt facilities, and should not be the sole account-holder for tax registration and corporate governance mandates. A domestic Spanish bank account remains mandatory for statutory purposes.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance of the managing director or legal representative is the standard requirement for non-resident shareholders or directors when opening a corporate account with tier-1 Spanish banks. A notarized and apostilled power of attorney (poder) can enable remote opening through a branch agent, but many banks additionally require a commercial visit or domiciliary verification at the SL's registered office. Video-identification is permitted only for individuals in specific circumstances under Law 10/2010; it is generally impossible for fully remote non-resident corporate onboarding. Resident directors with a digital Spanish NIF certificate (DNIe/certificado digital) may use certain banks' online onboarding, subject to enhanced due diligence for foreign UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain disclosure gap for non-resident shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of good standing from the registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction, complete organizational chart with UBO percentage holdings, Spanish fiscal identification (NIF) for each shareholder, and a legal opinion confirming that the agency provides ASO, SEO, and localization services falling outside the FATF high-risk sectors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-flow mismatch: high-volume incoming collections from online advertising platforms without physical invoicing trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed managed-service agreements, platform payout statements (Google Ads, Apple App Store, Amazon), itemized invoices with ASO/SEO deliverables, screen captures of campaign dashboards, and a GAAP-compliant revenue recognition policy consistent with Janus and IFRS 15.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax residence of beneficial owners triggering adverse media or PEP flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: W-8BEN-E or Spanish form 030 residence certificate for each non-resident shareholder, double-tax-treaty residence certificate issued by the home tax authority, audited financial statements, and notarized statutory declarations of non-PEP status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or politically exposed person screening hit against a signatory or UBO
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent name-screening and adverse-media reports, copies of passports or identity cards, proof of source of wealth (bank statements, asset declarations), and a professional legal opinion from a Spanish AML compliance counsel demonstrating that any screening match is false positive or limited to a de minimis historic event.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity contributions or subordinated shareholder loans must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 wire from the investor's bank account; the payment reference field must clearly state 'Aportación de capital – NIF [SL-issued number]' or 'Préstamo mercantil socios – NIF [SL-issued number]'. The receiving Spanish bank will record the transaction for the Banco de España's Balance of Payments. If the injection constitutes foreign direct investment exceeding €3,005 or exceeding the threshold requiring registration (generally 10% of share capital), the SL must file the Declaración de Inversión Exterior through the Ministry's Commercial and Investment Directorate online system within one month of the transaction. The SL must retain the SWIFT confirmation, bank receipt/capital deposit certificate, notarized minutes of the shareholders' meeting approving the increase, and the registration certificate from the Mercantile Registry.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Spanish clearing rails for trade settlements are dominated by Target2/SEPA for euro disbursements (SEPA Instant and SEPA Credit Transfer) and SWIFT MT103/MT202 for non-euro or non-EEA transactions. Payments for service suppliers, freelancers, and advertising platforms must be executed through an authorized Spanish credit institution to ensure proper tax audit trail and compliance with the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) e-invoicing data reporting. For high-value cross-border procurement (e.g., purchasing white-label ASO tooling), an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (UCP600) issued/confirmed by a Spanish bank is accepted in practice, although most agency disbursements are plain-vanilla SWIFT transfers. The use of ACH/automated clearing house networks is not customary; payee IBAN and BIC/SWIFT codes are mandatory.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forward contracts with physical delivery
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies where physical delivery is not possible or is restricted by local law
Cross-currency swaps (XCY) under ISDA 2002 Master Agreements
European-style FX options (OTC or exchange-traded) with mark-to-market collateral arrangements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (Cuentas Anuales: balance sheet, profit-and-loss account, statement of changes in equity and notes) together with the management report, approved by the shareholders' meeting and deposited with the Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (Commercial Registry) via the Deposito de Cuentas telematic portal of the Registro Mercantil Central
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit within 1 month of approval, i.e. effectively by July 31 following a December 31 fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-deposit fine of EUR 1,000-12,000, raised to EUR 12,000-120,000 if net turnover exceeds EUR 6M; failure to deposit within 12 months after the deadline triggers cierre registral (closure of the company's registry sheet, blocking further registrations); permanent registry closure after 3 years; joint liability of directors; no administrative strike-off in Spain, but persistent non-disclosure supports judicial dissolution actions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax self-assessment return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed during the first 25 calendar days of July following the tax year (July 1-25 for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5%-20% of the assessed liability depending on delay tier plus late-payment interest (currently 3.75% per annum); minimum penalty of EUR 200; a return filed only after formal demand carries a 50%-150% penalty; enforced collection via embargo; recurrent non-compliance may found insolvency and dissolution proceedings rather than administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership (Declaracion de Titularidad Real, DTR) confirming the chain of natural-person owners and controllers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro de Titularidades Reales administered by the Registro Mercantil Central (online DTR service)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the month of January (by January 31) and additionally within one month after any change in ultimate beneficial ownership, board control, or shareholding transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-conforming declarations are refused and the underlying corporate acts go unregistered; AML sanctions under Ley 10/2010 range from EUR 1,500 (minor) to EUR 150,000 (serious); successive failures generate registry blocks preventing further filings, share transfers, and appointments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT recapitulative return (Modelo 390) and, where applicable, annual third-party transactions information return (Modelo 347)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Modelo 390 due January 1-30 following the calendar year; Modelo 347 due February 28 following the calendar year when third-party transactions exceeded EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing without assessed amount carries a flat EUR 150 fine, rising to EUR 6,000 or 1% of the tax due plus delay interest; misdeclaration is treated as irregular omission with a 10%-150% penalty scale; chronic non-filing invites an AEAT inspection file and ancillary insolvency measures, not administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada must undergo an independent statutory audit when it meets at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive fiscal years: balance-sheet total exceeding EUR 2,850,000; net annual turnover exceeding EUR 5,700,000; average workforce exceeding 50 employees. Audit is also compulsory for parent companies required to present consolidated accounts and for any company whose shares or other securities are admitted to a Spanish or EU regulated market. Shareholders holding at least 5% of share capital may petition the Mercantile Registry registrador to order an audit even when statutory thresholds are not met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad, PGC) approved by RD 1514/2007 for larger entities and the simplified PGC de Pymes approved by RD 1515/2007 for SME exemptions (assets below EUR 4M, turnover below EUR 8M, fewer than 50 employees); both frameworks are aligned to EU-endorsed IFRS, while full IFRS-EU is mandatory only for consolidated financial statements of groups; accounts must be prepared in euros and in Spanish.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every share transfer or change of ultimate beneficial ownership must be documented in a notarized public deed, entered in the consented Register of Members, and communicated to the Registro Mercantil; the updated Declaracion de Titularidad Real must be electronically refiled within one month after the transfer or change, and an annual reconfirmation of the full beneficial-ownership chain is required during the month of January each year even where no alteration occurred; failure to reconfirm voids the efficacy of subsequent registrations, prejudices the evidentiary value of the registers, and exposes the SL and its administrators to AML penalties under Ley 10/2010.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350-1,800 (EUR 300-1,500) per annum for a compliant registered office, corporate mail handling, and standardized governance support; Madrid and Barcelona prime-address business centers typically range USD 1,400-2,800 (EUR 1,200-2,500) per annum.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,200-16,000 (EUR 3,000-15,000) per engagement for a single-entity statutory or voluntary audit by an auditor inscribed in the Registro Oficial de Auditores de Cuentas (ROAC); small PGC-Pyme audits with simple revenue streams generally sit at the lower band, while IFRS or group audits commence above USD 20,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% statutory rate with applicable incentives including deductions for R&D expenditure, innovation activities, and specific regional incentives; no broad tax holidays

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return filed electronically through the Agencia Tributaria portal (www.agenciatributaria.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months following the end of the tax year (e.g. 25 July for calendar year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of net taxable income after adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Spanish resident companies file Modelo 100; non-residents file Modelo 100BIS for permanent establishment income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of corporate income tax liability
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents, apply withholding or estimated payments; file Modelo 100BIS if applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties of 100 euros per day with a maximum of 2,000 euros; additional 1% of the tax due per month of delay up to 20%

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders (reduced by applicable double tax treaties)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain a Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) from the Spanish tax authorities or withholding agent; submit supporting documentation including beneficial ownership declaration and TRC application form
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory, reduced to 0-10% under treaties; Interest: 19% statutory, often 0% under EU directives and treaties for related party debt interest

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 20 million euros annual net turnover triggers mandatory local file and master file preparation for related party transactions
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to Spanish companies classified as pure equity holding entities or those lacking substantial economic activity; requires core income generating activities in Spain with qualified employees and premises

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate failure to declare taxable income or overstatement of deductions in the CIT return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including fines equivalent to 100% to 150% of the evaded tax amount and imprisonment for up to 2 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability for directors and administrators; possible disqualification from management positions and asset seizure

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or maintain adequate transfer pricing documentation or applying non-arm's length pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 5 million euros or 5% of group turnover; potential adjustment of taxable base by tax authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for tax adjustments; possible administrative sanctions and reputational damage

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a shell company without adequate economic substance in Spain for tax residency purposes
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax residency, recharacterization of income, and fines up to 1 million euros or 10% of turnover
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for false declarations; potential criminal proceedings and travel restrictions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Taxes on Distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold and remit Spanish withholding tax on dividends, royalties, or interest paid to non-resident entities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of 100% to 200% of the withheld tax amount plus interest; possible criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for non-compliance; fines and possible imprisonment for willful evasion
